src/Cluckwork.Application/Common/AppErro.name: Application error
src/Cluckwork.Application/Common/AppErro.description: The shape of a failure the app reports back, such as a refused action, with a code and a message.

src/Cluckwork.Application/Common/AuditAc.name: Activity log action names
src/Cluckwork.Application/Common/AuditAc.description: The fixed list of names for each kind of action recorded in the activity log, so entries are consistent and checkable.

src/Cluckwork.Application/Common/Credent.name: Credential marker
src/Cluckwork.Application/Common/Credent.description: A label placed on data that holds a password or key under an unobvious name, so it is kept out of logs.

src/Cluckwork.Application/Common/IAuditW.name: Activity log writer outline
src/Cluckwork.Application/Common/IAuditW.description: Describes adding an entry to the activity log so it is saved or undone together with the change it records.

src/Cluckwork.Application/Common/IClock..name: Clock outline
src/Cluckwork.Application/Common/IClock..description: Describes asking for the current time, so tests can use a fixed time.

src/Cluckwork.Application/Common/ICurren.name: Current transaction outline
src/Cluckwork.Application/Common/ICurren.description: Describes finding out which database transaction the current piece of work is running in, if any.

src/Cluckwork.Application/Common/ICurren.name: Current user outline
src/Cluckwork.Application/Common/ICurren.description: Describes who is doing the current action: the signed-in person, or a named system task when no person is involved.

src/Cluckwork.Application/Common/IFarmCl.name: Farm calendar outline
src/Cluckwork.Application/Common/IFarmCl.description: Describes the farm's local today, shared by every rule that depends on dates such as no future-dated entries and first-in-first-out sales.

src/Cluckwork.Application/Common/IFlockS.name: Worker flock restriction outline
src/Cluckwork.Application/Common/IFlockS.description: Describes the rule that workers may record production only for the flocks they are assigned to.

src/Cluckwork.Application/Common/IUnitOf.name: Save changes outline
src/Cluckwork.Application/Common/IUnitOf.description: Describes saving a batch of changes all together.

src/Cluckwork.Application/Common/PagedRe.name: Paged list result
src/Cluckwork.Application/Common/PagedRe.description: The shape of one page of a long list, with a marker for fetching the next page.

src/Cluckwork.Application/Common/ResultL.name: Refusal logging
src/Cluckwork.Application/Common/ResultL.description: Logs expected refusals, such as a rejected sale, as warnings with a stable reason code so they can be searched.

src/Cluckwork.Application/Common/Securit.name: Security event names
src/Cluckwork.Application/Common/Securit.description: The fixed names for security-related happenings, such as failed sign-ins, so they can be monitored without reading free text.

src/Cluckwork.Application/Common/SystemA.name: System actor labels
src/Cluckwork.Application/Common/SystemA.description: Names shown in the activity log for actions done by the system itself rather than a person.

src/Cluckwork.Domain/Auditing/AuditEvent.name: Activity log entry
src/Cluckwork.Domain/Auditing/AuditEvent.description: A permanent record of an important change: who did it, when, what it affected and why. Entries are only ever added.

src/Cluckwork.Domain/Auditing/ConnectedA.name: Connected app
src/Cluckwork.Domain/Auditing/ConnectedA.description: Identifies the connected app a person used to make a change.

src/Cluckwork.Domain/Common/AggregateRoo.name: Main record base
src/Cluckwork.Domain/Common/AggregateRoo.description: The shared base for the main records that own their related details and are saved as a unit.

src/Cluckwork.Domain/Common/Architecture.name: Code boundary labels
src/Cluckwork.Domain/Common/Architecture.description: Labels used to declare which area owns which code and which areas may depend on each other.

src/Cluckwork.Domain/Common/Architecture.name: Module rules: Accounts and access
src/Cluckwork.Domain/Common/Architecture.description: Declares, for the accounts and access area, which parts of the code it owns and which other areas it is allowed to depend on, so automated checks can catch broken boundaries.

src/Cluckwork.Domain/Common/Architecture.name: Module rules: Sales
src/Cluckwork.Domain/Common/Architecture.description: Declares, for the sales area, which parts of the code it owns and which other areas it is allowed to depend on, so automated checks can catch broken boundaries.

src/Cluckwork.Domain/Common/Architecture.name: Module rules: Egg operations
src/Cluckwork.Domain/Common/Architecture.description: Declares, for the egg operations area, which parts of the code it owns and which other areas it is allowed to depend on, so automated checks can catch broken boundaries.

src/Cluckwork.Domain/Common/Architecture.name: Module rules: Farm setup
src/Cluckwork.Domain/Common/Architecture.description: Declares, for the farm setup area, which parts of the code it owns and which other areas it is allowed to depend on, so automated checks can catch broken boundaries.

src/Cluckwork.Domain/Common/Architecture.name: Module rules: Expenses
src/Cluckwork.Domain/Common/Architecture.description: Declares, for the expenses area, which parts of the code it owns and which other areas it is allowed to depend on, so automated checks can catch broken boundaries.

src/Cluckwork.Domain/Common/Architecture.name: Module rules: Flocks
src/Cluckwork.Domain/Common/Architecture.description: Declares, for the flock management area, which parts of the code it owns and which other areas it is allowed to depend on, so automated checks can catch broken boundaries.

src/Cluckwork.Domain/Common/Architecture.name: Module rules: General inventory
src/Cluckwork.Domain/Common/Architecture.description: Declares, for the general inventory area, which parts of the code it owns and which other areas it is allowed to depend on, so automated checks can catch broken boundaries.

src/Cluckwork.Domain/Common/Architecture.name: Module rules: Reports and insights
src/Cluckwork.Domain/Common/Architecture.description: Declares, for the reports and insights area, which parts of the code it owns and which other areas it is allowed to depend on, so automated checks can catch broken boundaries.

src/Cluckwork.Domain/Common/Architecture.name: Module rules: Platform
src/Cluckwork.Domain/Common/Architecture.description: Declares, for the shared platform area, which parts of the code it owns and which other areas it is allowed to depend on, so automated checks can catch broken boundaries.

src/Cluckwork.Domain/Common/Entity.cs.name: Record base
src/Cluckwork.Domain/Common/Entity.cs.description: The shared base for any record with its own identity.

src/Cluckwork.Domain/Common/Error.cs.name: Error
src/Cluckwork.Domain/Common/Error.cs.description: A named failure with a code and message, used when an action is refused.

src/Cluckwork.Domain/Common/ICreatedReco.name: Created-record marker
src/Cluckwork.Domain/Common/ICreatedReco.description: Marks records that note when and by whom they were created.

src/Cluckwork.Domain/Common/IDomainEvent.name: Event marker
src/Cluckwork.Domain/Common/IDomainEvent.description: Marks something that happened in the farm's records that other parts may react to.

src/Cluckwork.Domain/Common/IMutableReco.name: Changed-record marker
src/Cluckwork.Domain/Common/IMutableReco.description: Marks records that note when and by whom they were last changed.

src/Cluckwork.Domain/Common/Money.cs.name: Money
src/Cluckwork.Domain/Common/Money.cs.description: A money amount held as a whole number of the smallest currency unit, such as cents, to avoid rounding errors.

src/Cluckwork.Domain/Common/Result.cs.name: Success or failure result
src/Cluckwork.Domain/Common/Result.cs.description: The standard outcome of an action: it either succeeded, with a value, or failed with an error.

src/Cluckwork.Domain/Common/ValueObject..name: Value object base
src/Cluckwork.Domain/Common/ValueObject..description: The shared base for small values, such as an amount, that are equal when their contents are equal.
